acceptanceCriteria: Costs are regenerated from retained hosted go test -json package outcomes by a checked-in tool, with the source run recorded.
A drift check reports when an observed package time differs from its table entry by more than a stated factor or a package is missing.
Full mode still runs every package exactly once; an invalid or missing weight keeps the existing complete fallback.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 during a CI audit (Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Tasks build 202) at origin/main e5d47da8; hosted run https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/37198363933 (4 shards, 295 packages, 5635s summed package time, race steps 1924/1647/1397/1264s). Confirmed: .github/cishards/package-costs.json (last changed 960ee04c, 2026-10-01) has 253 entries for 295 packages. internal/testacceptance is recorded as 3220ms and ran 953.5s; internal/behaviorfalsify is recorded 910s and ran 98s; internal/doccorpus/selfcorpus (144s) and internal/postmergeworkflow (44s) are missing. Observed shard test sums 1706/1544/1135/1248s against an ideal 1409s; other runs the same day reached 2204s on one shard. The table is hand-maintained and under .github/, so every refresh needs an admin control-plane acceptance. Related: V1-0617 (balancing, delivered by PR 425).

completion.reason: V1-0714 delivered by beamfall/corvint#523, merge commit 9e3e3fd285613e263050ab138af0ba6489ad4f8a, with required checks green; full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN under the owner's standing scoped-work preference in AGENTS.md, manual disposition on focused tests, hosted required checks and independent review; evidence digests are sha256 of these files at that commit: 9e3e3fd2:docs/build-log/2026-10-04-ci-shard-cost-refresh.md e9f4dd17268b561ed79a8b80e81bb60070e3335ada78040d92ed1050bde3e1e0; 9e3e3fd2:tools/ci-shard-costs/main.go 74e53a2509e8eabdb845c97c2fee0efd1bb57d945765d518fb07c2f37e324bb8; 9e3e3fd2:tools/ci-shard-costs/main_test.go 4c5ce96076d410295a034c4f205e504bc533058194dc3877d06c7311d21940d7; 9e3e3fd2:.github/cishards/package-costs.json b263612a7cba376b9151967b47d80c7199f01d4445ccbc64bb5d386acd933e82; 9e3e3fd2:.github/cishards/partition.go ad317076f1f3fc3a793f15f52ff2e253ae17586349652013bb4cefc8fc4702ab. AC1: tools/ci-shard-costs regenerates .github/cishards/package-costs.json from retained hosted go test -json package outcomes; the source run is recorded in the table and in docs/build-log/2026-10-04-ci-shard-cost-refresh.md. AC2: the tool's check mode reports a package whose observed time differs from its entry by more than the stated factor and any missing package (tools/ci-shard-costs/main_test.go). AC3: .github/cishards/partition.go keeps every package exactly once in full mode and falls back to the complete partition on an invalid or missing weight.
